why: Single-card patch measured for a yay/nay (2026-09-11): Dusk Legion Sergeant for Stroke of Midnight. a two-mana Vampire (an eminence trigger) whose sacrifice gives every nontoken Vampire persist for the turn -- a second life against the wipe that ends most of the deck's games; interaction reads 12 against a 5-6 target, and Stroke is a three-mana spot removal The goldfish cannot see what this card does, so its objective is a CONTROL; Forge at standard-v3 on the deck's own seeds is the instrument, and its engine-casts block says whether the AI played it.
